newsitem.title: USA: Microware Systems cites spending in Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Microware Systems cites spending in Q4 loss.

text.p: Microware Systems Corp said Friday that higher spending tied to development costs in new markets contibuted to a net loss in the fourth quarter ended March 31.

The company said it lost $2.5 million, or $0.18 a share, compared to a profit of $0.5 million, or $0.04, in the same period a year ago. Total revenues fell to $6.2 million from $6.8 million in the fourth quarter of 1996.

Microware also said its most recent results were affected by a special one-time charge related to the consolidation of its European operations, a move the company expects will increase profitability in the next fiscal year.
The company is also revising its pricing and product models, which it said should also help its margins.
Its shares were unchanged Friday at 6-7/8.
